subject: URGENT: Payroll export failing due to M365 permission error
body: Hi IT team, I cannot run the monthly payroll batch export. It keeps throwing error: 'M365 Access Denied: Insufficient Graph API Scope'. Today is payroll processing deadline. Please help immediately!

triage_metadata.root_cause_hypothesis: Missing Azure AD Graph API application permissions for Payroll Service Principal.
triage_metadata.suggested_troubleshooting: Grant temporary elevated scope 'User.ReadWrite.All' via Microsoft Entra ID admin portal.

subject: VPN keeps dropping every 10 minutes
body: Since morning the corporate OpenVPN client disconnects with a TLS handshake timeout error. I've restarted my laptop twice but no luck. Working remotely from home.

triage_metadata.root_cause_hypothesis: Expired SSL/TLS client certificate or UDP port 1194 throttling by local ISP.
triage_metadata.suggested_troubleshooting: Push refreshed client ovpn configuration bundle with TCP 443 fallback via Intune.

subject: Suspicious email with invoice attachment
body: I received an email claiming to be from our CEO asking to review an urgent PDF invoice from a strange domain (ceo-proglite-verify.com). I haven't clicked it. Is this a phishing attack?

triage_metadata.root_cause_hypothesis: Potential spear-phishing attack impersonating executive management.
triage_metadata.suggested_troubleshooting: Quarantine sender domain (ceo-proglite-verify.com) in M365 Defender, pull email from inboxes.

subject: Need second monitor cable for desk 4B
body: Hi, I moved to a new desk in 4B. Need an HDMI to USB-C display converter cable whenever IT stock has spare. No rush.

triage_metadata.root_cause_hypothesis: Standard peripheral hardware request for workstation setup.
triage_metadata.suggested_troubleshooting: Check IT inventory cabinet in Block B, log asset barcode in Jira Service Management.
